Taxable Purchases per Supplier — Transactions

This report shows all taxable purchase transactions for a specific supplier within a selected date range.

It includes purchase invoices and debit notes that contain tax amounts, helping you track taxable purchases from individual suppliers.

What This Report Shows

The report displays a detailed list of transactions with the following information:

• Transaction date and reference number

• Document type (purchase invoice or debit note)

• Description of the purchase

• Tax amounts applied to each transaction

• Running totals of taxable purchases

Using This Report

This report is useful for:

• Reviewing all taxable purchases from a specific supplier

• Verifying tax amounts charged by suppliers

• Preparing supplier-specific tax documentation

• Reconciling supplier statements with your tax records

Report Options

You can filter this report by:

• Date range - Select the period you want to analyze

• Accounting basis - Choose between cash basis (when paid) or accrual basis (when invoiced)
